name: KLUE
description: Korean Language Understanding Evaluation (KLUE) is a benchmark suite of 8 Korean NLU tasks including classification, similarity, inference, named entity recognition, relation extraction, dependency parsing, machine reading comprehension, and dialogue state tracking, designed to accelerate Korean NLP research.
reputation: KLUE is the standard Korean NLU benchmark suite and is widely used in Korean NLP research and model comparisons.
notes: All tasks built from scratch with ethical considerations; includes pretrained models KLUE-BERT and KLUE-RoBERTa; publicly available.
